Name: Baking With Pride
Author: JinxxShadows
Description:
Currently Baking With Pride consists of a total of 16 recipes, but will eventually contain more. These are round cakes, their designs based off of the following pride flags: LGBT, WLW, MLM, Bi, Pan, Trans, Asexual, Aromantic, the 1977 pride flag, Genderqueer, Genderfluid, Agender, Demigirl, Demiboy, and Aroace. 

What I plan for the next update:
-adding cookie wafers of at least 8 or more flags
-possibly editing the cake designs

Downloads.Description: Changed the recipe for Demiboy Delights.
